name: claims-squad-orchestrator
description: Writes a claim file summary from adjuster notes for a homeowners claim under the HO-0304..HO-0309 endorsements. Decomposes the claim, delegates coverage/exclusion lookup and note summarisation to two internal workers, and returns the eight-heading summary with a [SOURCE: chunk_id | form_number | clause_id] tag on every coverage statement. Does not pay, deny or settle anything.

provider.organization: AI Engineering League - Set D (insurance claims)

adjusterBearer.description: Short-lived token scoped to claims:summary:read. Holds no payment or settlement scope.

skills.name: Summarise a claim file
skills.description: Adjuster notes plus the policy forms on file in; CLAIM NUMBER / DATE OF LOSS / POLICY FORMS / LOSS SUMMARY / DEDUCTIBLE / COVERAGE POSITION / EXCLUSIONS APPLIED / OPEN ITEMS out. Coverage statements are cited to the indexed endorsement wording or marked undetermined. If the coverage worker is unavailable the task goes to input-required, not completed.
examples: Summarise claim CLM-2024-31842: notes attached, policy forms HO-0304.
